Ride This City Tokyo

Tokyo, Japan · Jingumae, Shibuya (Cat Street) · Road

Ride This City Tokyo is a road group ride in Tokyo, Japan. It rolls every Saturday at 9:30 am local time from Rapha Tokyo. Pace: around 25 km/h.

For visitors

Open ride: no RCC membership needed. Free, but book on Rapha's event site (an Easol account, then name, phone and emergency contact). The listing is in Japanese and English. The clubhouse has bike racks; the café opens at noon.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: around 25 km/h.
Check
Look at @rapha.tokyo the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ride This City Tokyo group ride

Rapha Tokyo's weekly open Saturday ride from the clubhouse on Cat Street. 30 to 40 km through the city at about 25 km/h, back by 12:30; the route is posted on RideWithGPS. The clubhouse also runs members-only RCC rides (the Arakawa Classic on Sunday mornings, the Yanokuchi Classic on Saturdays at 7:00).
